protocol.normalization: Unicode NFKC, collapse all whitespace runs to one ASCII space, strip ends

pair_complete_sensitivity.rule: keep the frozen selection unchanged; exclude the known insufficient 2022-03 rank-2 record and the corresponding 2026-03 rank-2 record from this secondary NCD analysis

interpretation.statement: Between-year NCD is not larger than within-year NCD in either the primary 35-record analysis or the balanced 17-vs-17 sensitivity analysis. These descriptive results do not support a stable publication-year separation in this fixed note cohort.
limits: The cohort is a feature-blind high-engagement sample selected from a fixed note editorial-recommendation candidate set, not a random sample of all note articles.
One frozen 2022 selection record is shorter than the 1,000-character measurement contract and is retained as insufficient_length rather than replaced.
NCD is used as a cohort similarity measurement, not a single-article publication-year classifier.
